messages.subject: Interview opportunity - Senior Software Engineer
messages.body:
Hi Sam,

I'm working with a confidential client, a fast-growing fintech, on a Senior Software Engineer search. They'd like to set up a coding interview with you on Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 11:00 AM PT.

I can't share the company name yet. Let me know if that works!

Chris Vale
Apex Staffing
